about_the_game:
This is not a fight. This is survival. You enter the zone with the gear you bring and leave with the gear you carry. Death means losing your hard-earned items and all the valuable loot you collected.

  • Pure Evasion Horror: You are defenceless. Your only chance is to outsmart, distract, and run. Use the environment to your advantage, manage your noise level, and pray you remain unseen.

  • High-Stakes Extraction: Secure your mission objectives valuable classified data, priceless artifacts, or volatile resources and make it to the extraction point before the horrors track you down.

  • Tactical Stealth: Sound is your greatest enemy. Master the art of silent movement to increase your chances of getting out alive.

  • Variable Contracts: Accept missions from your secure hideout, ranging from quick smash-and-grabs to deep dives into the most dangerous sectors for legendary, high-value loot.

The Hideout

Your secure base is your only sanctuary a place to safely secure your permanent upgrades and prepare for the next terrifying run.

  • Build Your Base: Invest your extracted wealth into upgrading your hideout. Unlock crucial facilities like advanced crafting stations, stealth tool labs, and research benches to unlock permanent benefits and enhance your evasion gear.

  • Customize Your Loadout: Craft specialized tools for every scenario.

  • Solo or Squad: Go it alone in tense, quiet desperation, or team up with up to 4 other players. Collaborate on mission objectives, split the risks, and cover each other's backs when the monsters close in.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some strong language and adult themes.

name: Devil's Crew

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Devil's Crew is a terrifying Co-op/Solo Horror Extraction experience. You have no weapons, no defence only your wits and your will to survive. Descend into forgotten, haunted zones to secure valuable assets, evade the grotesque horrors within, and race to the extraction point.
